question: For male legislators from Louisiana, how many distinct legislators were actively serving on December 31 of each year from more than 30 years since their first term up to less than 50 years, grouping the results by the exact number of years elapsed since their first term?
sql:
WITH la_male_first_term AS (
  SELECT l.id_bioguide, 
         MIN(CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE)) AS first_term_start
  FROM legislators l
  JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
  WHERE l.gender = 'M' AND lt.state = 'LA'
  GROUP BY l.id_bioguide
),
dec31_dates AS (
  SELECT date '1800-12-31' + (n * INTERVAL '1 year') AS dec31
  FROM generate_series(0, 250) AS g(n)
),
serving_on_dec31 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.id_bioguide, d.dec31
  FROM legislators l
  JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
  JOIN dec31_dates d ON CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= d.dec31 AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) >= d.dec31
  WHERE l.gender = 'M' AND lt.state = 'LA'
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT s.id_bioguide, s.dec31,
         CAST(date_diff('day', f.first_term_start, s.dec31) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS years_elapsed
  FROM serving_on_dec31 s
  JOIN la_male_first_term f ON s.id_bioguide = f.id_bioguide
  WHERE CAST(date_diff('day', f.first_term_start, s.dec31) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) > 30 AND CAST(date_diff('day', f.first_term_start, s.dec31) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) < 50
)
SELECT years_elapsed, COUNT(DISTINCT id_bioguide) AS distinct_legislators
FROM filtered
GROUP BY years_elapsed
ORDER BY years_elapsed
